proposal.rationale: Refined patterns for SD. Chapter 36-1 is the veterans' reinstatement chapter applying broadly to "any profession, trade, science or business" regulated by the state — sections 36-1-1 through 36-1-3 use general language including "this chapter shall operate retroactively" to all professions. Chapter 36-1D's section 36-1D-4 explicitly says "provisions of this chapter apply to any [occupation licensed pursuant to title 36]" — added a generic "provisions of this chapter apply to" universal pattern. Chapter 36-2 (Section 36-2-1, 36-2-2, 36-2-3) regulates the "healing art" generally and is not universal across professions — those should remain undetermined/profession-specific (medicine). Kept other patterns from the prior version. Did not add a pattern for 36-2 since it is a specific practice act for healing arts.
